name: S.RESET — Reset calibration
description: Sensor settings action row: opens the reset-calibration confirm for the sensor of the current level. — laid out to the §7 per-sensor template, minus the editor rows it has no value to edit.

elements.bound: fixed literal; abbreviated so it clears nav-position at x=168
depth 0..3 (UiNavigator::kMaxDepth) and position within a ring of at most 8; this row is what takes the sensor-settings ring from 7 declared members to 8, and 8/8 is still six characters
which sensor the reset applies to; 1..8, or - when none is implied. The one fact this screen cannot be allowed to omit, because the action is per channel
fixed literal; names the effect in the vocabulary of the rows above, which each edit one of the fields it clears
fixed literal, and emphasised rather than muted on purpose: it is the half of the behaviour an operator would otherwise assume the opposite of
shared footer vocabulary, see 7.1. ENTER opens a confirm rather than editing, so it does not claim 'edit' like the S1..S6 rows
geometry; 100px so it stops clear of the banner row at y=116
